definition: דָּשֵׁן verb be fat, grow fat (Arabic ; whence also grease, fat ; Late Hebrew דִּשֵּׁן make fat , compare Late Hebrew דֶּשֶׁן fat ) — Qal Perfect 3 masculine singular וְדָשֵׁן consecutive Deut 31:20 ( J E ) figurative of Israel's prosperity. Pi`el Perfect דִּשַּׁנְתָּ Ps 23:5 וְדִשְּׁנוּ consecutive Num 4:13 Imperfect : יְדַשְּׁנֶהֶֿסּלָה Ps 20:4 volunt. (compare Ges «GKC:48»§ 48 , 3 De ; but perhaps read suffix נֶהָ -, נָהּ - see Ki Gee l.c .); 3 feminine singular תְּדַשֶּׁןֿ Prov 15:30 Infinitive לְדַשְּׁנוֺ Exod 27:3 — causative make fat בשׁמן ׳ ד ראשׁי i.e. anoint, symbol of festivity and joy Ps 23:5 עָ֑צֶם ׳ ד Prov 15:30 of bodily effect of good news; עולה ׳ ד find a burnt-offering fat = acceptable Ps 20:4 elsewhere denominative from דֶּשֶׁן (fat ashes); — take away, clear away the fat ashes (accusative of altar cleared) Num 4:13 ( P ), so סירות לְדַשְּׁנוֺ Exod 27:3 ( P ). Pu`al Imperfect יְדֻשָּׁ֑ן Prov 28:25 ; Isa 34:7 3 feminine singular תְּדֻשָּׁן Prov 11:25 ; Prov 13:4 — passive of causation Pi`el be made fat , of dust saturated מֵחַלֶב Isa 34:7 figurative of prosperity of the liberal Prov 11:25 , the diligent Prov 13:4 , the trustful Prov 28:25 . Hothpa`al Perfect 3 feminine singular הֻדַּ֫שְׁנָה (compare Ol § 271 Ges «GKC:54»§ 54 . 3) Isa 34:6 , of Yahweh's sword: — it hath fattened itself מֵחֶלֶב || (מָֽלְאָה דָּםׅ
